name: Bun thit nuong
summary: Bún thịt nướng is grilled pork with rice noodles, a Da Nang bowl for a longer stay, at Con Market’s indoor counters and on Phạm Hồng Thái and Phan Tứ.
origin: Da Nang, on the city lists from 2019 and 2020.
howToEat: In Da Nang, eat it at Con Market or on Phạm Hồng Thái and Phan Tứ when you are staying longer than one lunch.

In Hoi An, Vietnam Tourism says barbecued pork, rice noodles, and salad greens are mixed into a thicker satay-type sauce than the northern bún chả dip. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 December 2025 article adds grilled pork skewers, herbs, crisp chả ram, and a sweet-sour fish sauce. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Con Market’s indoor counters, Phạm Hồng Thái at night, and Phan Tứ. The longer-stay list includes it.
In Hoi An, the old town. A house number and the hour are Check on arrival.

seoDescription: Bún thịt nướng is grilled pork with rice noodles. In Da Nang it is at Con Market, Phạm Hồng Thái, and Phan Tứ.
